blocks.text: Allaah's Name Al-Qawee The One Perfect in Strength comes in many places in the Noble Qur'aan. Allaah says,
Allah is very Gracious and Kind to His slaves. He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the All-Strong, the Almighty.
Allaah's Name Al-Mateen The Strong only appears once alongside the description of Allaah having strength. Allaah says,
Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.

'Mateen' means strong power. 'Qawee' means nothing is too difficult for Him. No one can overcome Him. His decree is not rejected, His Command is fulfilled and His Decree takes place in His creation. He honours whomever He wills, He debases whomever He wills. He helps whomever He wills, He forsakes whomever He wills. All power and strength is for Allaah. No one is helped except those He helps. No one is honoured except those whom He honours. Allaah says,
If Allah helps you, none can overcome you; and if He forsakes you, who is there after Him that can help you? And in Allah (Alone) let believers put their trust.

A servant's belief in this Name instills within him a sense of humility before Allaah, humbleness, fear of Him and makes him turn to Allaah alone. It makes a person rely upon Him sincerely, submitting to His Might and returning all his affairs to Him. It makes him assign might and power only to Allaah.

keyPoints: Al-Qawee comes in many places in the Qur'aan, while Al-Mateen appears only once, alongside the description of Allaah having strength (Dhaariyaat 51:58).
'Qawee' means nothing is too difficult for Him and no one can overcome Him; His Command is fulfilled and His Decree takes place in His creation.
He honours, debases, helps and forsakes whomever He wills; all power and strength is for Allaah.
Belief in this Name instills humility and fear of Allaah, and makes a person rely on Him alone and assign might and power only to Him.

evidence.text: Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.
If Allah helps you, none can overcome you; and if He forsakes you, who is there after Him that can help you?

recall.a: Nothing is too difficult for Him and no one can overcome Him; His decree is not rejected and His Command is fulfilled.

recall.q: How many times does Al-Mateen appear in the Qur'aan, and where?
recall.a: Only once, in Dhaariyaat 51:58: 'Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.'

recall.q: Which aayah does the author cite showing that no one can help if Allaah forsakes?
What does belief in this Name instill in the servant?
recall.a: Humility, humbleness, fear of Allaah, turning to Him alone, sincere reliance upon Him, and assigning might and power only to Him.
